summary: Full backend + frontend regression for ORCA marine intelligence app. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (health, boundaries, PFZ, 5 chat flows incl. flagship UNSAFE verdict, PFZ intent, Telugu, chlorophyll/SST 2 charts, alerts query, persistence, rate limiting, alerts count, notifications, geofence breach true/false, locations CRUD). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Chat empty state renders with 4 suggestions; tapping suggestion-0 triggers full agentic pipeline that returns UNSAFE verdict with SOURCES list and 7-agent REASONING TRACE (collapsible, toggles open showing Planner→Data Discovery→Weather Intelligence→Geospatial/Risk→Weather Intelligence(alerts)→Reporting/Visualization→Synthesizer); inline MAP widget block present (WebView unsupported-on-web message shown as expected, native map renders in Expo Go); language toggle switches UI strings to Telugu; new-session clears chat; Alerts tab shows ACTIVE HAZARDS (cyclone+lightning) + NOTIFICATIONS; Saved tab modal with name/lat/lon/use-my-location/vessel switch saves successfully; GEOFENCE action shows BREACH toast for 16.96/82.31 and navigates to Alerts where breach notification appears; ASK button deep-links to chat and auto-sends location-scoped query. Deterministic verdict is NOT overridden by LLM. No red-screen or console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:180 delete_location does both soft-delete (update_one) and hard-delete (delete_one) — soft-delete write is dead code. Minor.
In-memory rate limiter (_HITS defaultdict) is per-process; if backend is ever scaled to >1 worker/replica the 20/min guarantee breaks. Currently backend runs with --workers 1 so it works.

orchestrator/agents.py:77 _keyword_plan: precedence bug — `fish` triggers pfz_nearest even when the message is about safety (e.g. no 'fish' word normally, but the 'and' short-circuit `'fish' in m and 'declin' not in m` reads oddly). Consider parenthesising for clarity.
agents.py:_slim() converts boundaries list-of-dicts to list-of-names but leaves other large fields intact; acceptable for demo.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed locations/conversations/notifications; cleaned up after run (31 conv + 4 notif + 1 loc removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_orca_backend.py; pytest -n auto runs all in ~90s. Rate limit test uses concurrent burst (ThreadPoolExecutor 25 workers) because per-request LLM latency (~3s) otherwise drains the 60s window before hitting the 20-req cap. Backend supervisor runs uvicorn --workers 1 so the in-memory rate limiter is coherent. MapLibre WebView showing 'React Native WebView does not support this platform' on web preview is EXPECTED per main-agent note; verify only the MAP widget header block for web tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Everything requested in the review passes.
